import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem natural_iterate_period (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ) 
  (hperiod : ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + p) = f x) :
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + (n : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro x
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro x
    have h : x + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p = (x + (n : ℝ) * p) + p := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h, hperiod, ih]

  have h_base : ∀ (x : ℝ), f (x + (0 : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
    intro x
    simp [hperiod]
    <;>
    ring_nf at *
    <;>
    simp_all
  
  have h_inductive_step : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * p) = f x → f (x + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
    intro k x h_k

        <;> field_simp

  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + (n : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      calc
        f (x + (Nat.succ n : ℝ) * p) =
            f ((x + (n : ℝ) * p) + p) := by
              congr 1
              simp only [Nat.cast_succ]
              ring
        _ = f (x + (n : ℝ) * p) := hperiod (x + (n : ℝ) * p)
        _ = f x := ih x

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem natural_iterate_period (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ) 
  (hperiod : ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + p) = f x) :
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, f (x + (n : ℝ) * p) = f x := by
  intro n x
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_succ]
      calc
        f (x + ((n : ℝ) + 1) * p) = f ((x + (n : ℝ) * p) + p) := by
          congr 1
          ring
        _ = f (x + (n : ℝ) * p) := hperiod _
        _ = f x := ih
